name: cline
description: Autonomous coding agent CLI - capable of creating/editing files, running commands, using the browser, and more
run: npx -y cline@3.0.62 auth -p openai -k probe-mock-key -b ${MOCK_LLM_URL} -m probe-model && npx -y cline@3.0.62 --acp
notes: CLINE_DIR isolates cline's state dir; the auth subcommand preconfigures an openai-compatible provider against the mock LLM (documented headless path: -p/-k/-b/-m) before --acp starts. No cline account sign-in needed.
